title: Add Cursor Cloud specific instructions to AGENTS.md
body: ## Description Adds a `## Cursor Cloud specific instructions` section to `AGENTS.md` with non-obvious notes for future Cloud Agents: - Python venv setup using `uv` with Python 3.11 - Frontend uses Bun (`bun.lock`) - Unit test expectations (4175 pass, 30 skipped; confluence test needs Redis) - Docker services needed for integration/E2E tests (Docker not available on Cloud VMs) - Frontend dev server behavior without backend ## How Has This Been Tested? - Ran `pytest -xv backend/tests/unit --ignore=...confluence` (4175 passed, 30 skipped) - Verified `bun install` in `web/` succeeds - Verified `uv sync --group backend --group dev` installs all dependencies - Started `bun dev` on port 3002 — frontend loads (shows connection error without backend, expected) ## Additional Options - [ ] [Optional] Please cherry-pick this PR to the latest release version. - [ ] [Optional] Override Linear Check
